### Added

- (agent-platform) [Offer a new session when a session's sends keep timing out](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3231) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — When two messages in a row to a session time out before the agent starts, the session page says `This session may not be able to continue` and offers `Continue in a new session` with the whole conversation, beside the retry.
- (agent-platform) [Agents can start a connector sign-in, shown as an action in the session](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3239) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — An agent given a connector that needs your sign-in gets the sign-in tool, listed under `Added for sign-in` on the Tools step. In a session, the agent's sign-in link shows as a `Sign in to <connector>` button, and its question about it is answered once you are signed in.
- (agent-platform) [Resubscribe to a running turn when its live stream is cut](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3241) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — When the live connection to a running reply drops, for example during an Agent Platform update, the session page shows `The live view was interrupted. Reconnecting…` and continues the reply live instead of waiting for the next poll.
- (agent-platform) [Toolchains page and the start dialog's toolchain choice](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3245) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Customize has a Toolchains tab, where an installation runs the toolchain-manager, to browse toolchains with their versions and tools, `Add source`, and create one with `New toolchain` as a pull request. The New session dialog picks a session's toolchains.
- (agent-platform) [Name the runtime on the agent page and open it from Last used by you](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3249) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — An agent's page has a Runtime fact in the create form's words, e.g. Claude Code, marked `Platform default` where it is. The `Last used by you` cards in Customize's Agents tab open the agent's page instead of starting a session.
- (muster) [Draw nested forEach, parallelism, paginate and jq on the workflow page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3250) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A workflow's page draws loops inside loops, says how many items each runs at once (e.g. `one at a time`), marks steps `Paginated, up to N pages` or `jq transform`, and counts every step, as in `8 tool steps in 2 nested loops`.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [The workspace list follows a sync without a reload](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3235) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A workspace that is synchronizing, also right after it was created, reads `Synchronizing` in Customize's Workspaces tab and reaches its result without a reload. The list, the workspace's page and its `Synchronize` button show the same state.
- (agent-platform) [Keep the new-agent form's draft and open its links in a new tab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3234) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The new agent form keeps what you entered through a reload, Back or a followed link, says `Your draft is back` with `Start over`, and opens its links in a new tab.
- (agent-platform) [Call an agent's tenant its Organization, with Platform as its own choice](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3243) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Agents show the Organization they belong to instead of a tenant, with None and `Available to all organizations` for the platform's agents. The new agent form asks `Who the agent belongs to`: Platform or Organization, by plain name.
- (agent-platform) [Edit a workspace's exclusions and count them as the manager does](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3251) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The workspace editor shows each source's exclusions and lets you add and remove them, and counts repositories as the workspace-manager does, never negative. The Workspaces list drops its Sources column.
- (muster) [Offer a connector's sign-in instead of an auth error, and never retry a 401](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3236) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — If you haven't signed in to cluster-manager, GPU capacity, the model cache and Add GPU node pool offer its sign-in instead of an authentication error, and fill in once you have. A failed sign-in is no longer retried.

### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3242) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Updates the app test suite's Python project and lock file from the shared templates in giantswarm/github.
- (deps) [Update dependency react-syntax-highlighter to v16.1.2](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3238) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update dependency @playwright/test to v1.64.0](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3244) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (renovate) [Hold typescript below 7](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3247) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Renovate no longer proposes TypeScript 7, whose native compiler lacks the JavaScript API that typescript-eslint and the Storybook build load, until those support it.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.21.0...v3.22.0
